label: High-end Real Estate
heroHeading: An amenity that shows well and keeps working
seoDescription: Premium wellness installations for luxury developments. Differentiate properties with commercial-grade HBOT, sauna & cold therapy amenities.

valueProps.title: Something buyers remember
valueProps.body: A sauna and cold room read as a serious amenity on a tour, and they stay impressive years after handover.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Built for shared use by a whole building, with finishes that take heat and heavy traffic.

valueProps.title: Nothing for the building team to manage
valueProps.body: No plumbing or water treatment for the cold room. Residents book from an app, and the building manager sees faults remotely.

features.title: Planned into the drawings
features.body: We work from your floor plans: room sizes, ceiling heights, power and ventilation, so the amenity is built in rather than squeezed in.

features.title: Handover your operator can run
features.body: Training at handover, a cleaning routine that fits the daily round, and remote monitoring so nobody has to notice a problem first.
